description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Strago)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Strago)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities, casts Dual Magi Descendant after casting equipped two Wind attacks

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Strago)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Strago)] removes from the user

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Strago)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Wind abilities, casts Dual Wizened Mage's Ward when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed (max 3)

description.name: Dual Wizened Mage's Ward
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (3000)], smart ether 1 and [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]

description.name: HP Stock (3000)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 3000 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Dual Magi Descendant
description.text: Four single attacks (3.75 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
